title: polypogon tenellus
intro: Polypogon tenellus, commonly known as Small Hair Grass, is a perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The health benefits of Polypogon tenellus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
